title: Integrated Solid Waste Management Services (ISWM) McConnell AFB, Kansas

description:
Integrated Solid Waste Management Services (ISWM)  

  McConnell AFB, Kansas  

 The 22d Contracting Squadron, 22d Air Refueling Wing, is conducting market research to identify small-business concerns interested in and capable of performing Integrated Solid Waste Management (ISWM) services at McConnell AFB, Kansas. 

 This notice is for market-research and planning purposes only. It is not a solicitation, request for quotation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. The Government will not reimburse costs associated with responding to this notice. 

  Requirement  

 The anticipated contractor shall provide all personnel, supervision, equipment, tools, materials, vehicles, and other items necessary to perform ISWM services at McConnell AFB, except Government-furnished property identified in a future Performance Work Statement (PWS). Services shall comply with applicable Federal, state, and local laws, regulations, permits, commercial standards, and installation requirements. 

 The anticipated period of performance, including all option periods, is: 

  1 December 2027 through 30 November 2032  

 The anticipated NAICS code is  562111, Solid Waste Collection , with a small-business size standard of  $47 million . 

  Requested Information  

 Interested small-business concerns should submit a brief capability statement and letter of interest, not to exceed  10 pages , that includes: 

 
	  Company information:  Company name, CAGE code, UEI, address, primary point of contact, telephone number, email address, business size, and applicable socioeconomic status. 
	  Relevant experience:  Up to 10 recent and relevant Department of War, Federal, or commercial contracts. Include a brief description of work performed, contract number if applicable, contract type, value, period of performance, customer point of contact, and relevance to this anticipated requirement. 
	  Capability narrative:  A description of the company’s ability to perform ISWM services, including experience with waste collection, equipment, staffing, regulatory compliance, quality control, recycling or diversion programs, and any anticipated teaming or subcontracting arrangements. 
 

  Submission Instructions  

 Submit responses electronically in PDF or Microsoft Word format no later than: 

  1:00 p.m. CST, 25 November 2026  

 Submit responses to: 

  Adrian Arzate  
Administrator 
22d Contracting Squadron 
Email: adrian.arzate.3@us.af.mil 

  Sugeys Allen  
Contracting Officer 
22d Contracting Squadron 
Email: sugeys.allen.1@us.af.mil 

  Small-Business Consideration  

 The Government will use responses to this notice, along with other market research, to determine the appropriate acquisition strategy and whether a small-business or socioeconomic set-aside is appropriate. 

 This is a Sources Sought notice only. No solicitation is available at this time. If a solicitation is issued, it will be posted separately on SAM.gov.
